correctness.rationale: The precise independent directed-row construction gives a Poisson-binomial count after conditioning on global vertex colors. Fourier inversion has a single lattice saddle because basis difference types have linear abundance, giving local probability 4/(pi n)*exp(-||M||^2/n), with controllable uniform errors. Color CLT yields independent N(0,1/2) imbalances; their squared norm is Exp(1) and exponentiation gives U(0,1). Conditional Le Cam and exponential control of bad color samples prove distribution and all factorial-moment limits. Exact rational checker crosschecks finite normalization and direct arc enumeration.
